summary: Implemented an admin-only commission change-log projection backed by validated, already-redacted audit records, preserving before/after snapshots, actor, reason, effective dates, request/trace metadata, strict filters, pagination, and deterministic ordering.

verification.notes: Contracts compiled with strict change-log query, row, and envelope schemas.
Six focused commission tests passed, including validated audit projection, effective dates, filtering, authorization, IDOR, and invalid-source handling.
Workspace syntax, contracts, and API test typechecks passed.
Workspace checks and ESLint completed with zero warnings.
Workspace and API production builds succeeded.
Runtime API inventory completed; no routes changed because current commission HTTP composition is absent.

knownGaps: The change-log service requires a runtime adapter to the existing audit repository; current commission services do not yet emit commission audit records or have HTTP route composition.
No synthetic history is generated when an audit source is absent, and no production commission data was seeded.
Live database/provider integration checks were not run because no isolated replica-set topology or credentials were available.
